notes: Distinctive surname (Haranath), no same-name ambiguity encountered. High band is earned by THREE INDEPENDENT official domains that agree, not by Apollo's multiple pages alone: (1) apollohospitals.com - his own Hyderabad doctor page plus a separate pulmonologist listing, both stating Pulmonology, Apollo Health City Jubilee Hills, Hyderabad, 24 years; (2) apollo247.com - official Apollo 24|7 doctor/booking page, same name, specialty (Pulmonology Respiratory Medicine), Jubilee Hills location, 24 years, qualifications MBBS, AB Internal Medicine, AB Pulmonary & Critical Care, MPH, FCCP; (3) healinindia.gov.in - Government of India Advantage Healthcare India profile titled 'Dr. Sai Praveen Haranath - Pulmonology in Apollo Hospitals Hyderabad', an official .gov.in source that independently confirms name + specialty + hospital + city. Matched on four criteria vs the input row: name, specialty (Pulmonology), hospital (Apollo Health City Jubilee Hills), city, and experience (24+). A fourth, non-hospital corroboration comes from the International Hospital Federation profile, which states his Apollo roles (Senior Consultant Pulmonary & Critical Care, Medical Director Apollo eACCESS TeleICU, SVP Medical & Strategy Apollo Health Axis) and his US training. NO phone or email is published for him on any indexed official page - Apollo does not publish per-doctor direct lines - so both fields are deliberately left blank rather than derived from the hospital switchboard or any directory call-tracking number. No LinkedIn, Twitter/X, personal website, ORCID or Google Scholar profile surfaced in any query (searched explicitly); consistent with the known pattern for Hyderabad private-hospital consultants, and per the brief no further queries were spent hunting a scholarly ID. A YouTube video about rare lung diseases featuring him exists but it is on the Apollo Hospitals HOSPITAL channel, not his own account, so youtube was left blank per the no-hospital-social rule. IntechOpen, eMedEvents, Dosily, Skedoc and LogintoHealth are recorded as corroborating-only third-party profiles in other_profiles and were not used to justify the band.
